messages:
Alex W.: Hey team — QuantaCloud sent INV-7824 for Platform engineering services but it arrived with no PO attached. It landed in the invoice queue and is blocking payment. Invoiced entity says Product/Platform. Does anyone have the PO number or can confirm this should go against 2024-Q4 budget?
Priya S.: Ugh, I saw that one. No PO on the PDF. Vendor included a line items CSV though. Can you paste the invoice link?
Alex W.: https://invoices.redwood.example/INV-7824 — PDF + csv attached there. Looks like subscription + professional services.
Marcus L.: Possible match to PO 2024-PLAT-09 but that PO is for the subscription only, not the ad-hoc consult hours. Invoice shows 12 hours at $200/hr.
Elaine (AP): If PO 2024-PLAT-09 exists we can auto-match the subscription lines, but AP needs a valid PO or an approval note from the cost owner for the services lines. Who is the cost owner for those consult hours?
Priya S.: @Marcus L. and @Rohit (not in thread) split ownership — Marcus can you confirm ownership or add approval? :eyes:
Marcus L.: I can approve the extra services but we need written approval in Concur or an email thread to attach. I can add a short approval note: "Marcus L. approves QuantaCloud INV-7824 professional services, GL=6102, cost center=PLAT-OPS." Will that work?
Elaine (AP): That will work for manual routing. Please paste that exact text as a comment on the invoice record so AP has an auditable note. Also need to confirm whether to split charges across GL 6102 and GL 6103 per the CSV.
Alex W.: Done — added comment on the invoice with Marcus's approval text and a screenshot of Slack confirmation. I also flagged split lines per CSV: 70% GL 6102, 30% GL 6103.
finance-bot: Invoice INV-7824 status changed: "requires-approver-attachment" -> "manual-review". Approver: Marcus L.
Elaine (AP): Thanks. I'll route to payment once we have the PO link for the subscription lines. @Priya S. can you check whether PO 2024-PLAT-09 covers the subscription period on the invoice? If not, we need either PO amendment or move subscription to vendor prepaid charge.
Priya S.: Checking now — PO 2024-PLAT-09 covers Apr-Nov 2024, invoice period is Sep 2024 so subscription is covered. Sending PO PDF to invoice record.
Marcus L.: Confirmed. Subscription matched to PO 2024-PLAT-09. Professional services approved in-thread. Please proceed with approval routing.
Elaine (AP): Great — updating record: PO attached, approver note attached, split GL mapping entered. Marking for payment in next AP run. ETA payment: 3 business days. :white_check_mark:
Alex W.: Thanks everyone — leaving a note for future vendors: please include PO number on invoice header (2024-PLAT-09) to avoid manual hold. :pray:
Marcus L.: Will follow up with vendor contact to add PO on future invoices.
Priya S.: Closing this thread, will update the invoice job if anything else pops up.
